blogs.title: From 780GB to 48GB: How QLoRA Makes Giant LLM Finetuning a One‑GPU Job
blogs.description: A big‑picture tour of QLoRA’s breakthrough: finetuning a 65B‑parameter model on a single 48GB GPU with no quality loss versus 16‑bit training. We’ll unpack the core idea—backprop through a 4‑bit quantized base model into LoRA adapters—and why this changes who can build high‑quality chatbots.

blogs.title: NF4, Demystified: The 4‑bit Data Type That Keeps LLM Quality Intact
blogs.description: An accessible explainer of NormalFloat4 (NF4), the paper’s new 4‑bit data type designed for normally distributed weights. Learn how equal‑probability quantization bins, zero handling, and block‑wise scaling help NF4 outperform FP4 and Int4 without sacrificing accuracy.

blogs.title: Squeezing the Last Bits: Double Quantization and Paged Optimizers Explained
blogs.description: A deep dive into the two unsung heroes behind QLoRA’s memory savings. We’ll show how Double Quantization shrinks the overhead of quantization scales and how Paged Optimizers use NVIDIA unified memory to smooth out gradient‑checkpointing spikes—preventing out‑of‑memory errors on long sequences.

blogs.title: LoRA That Actually Matches 16‑bit: What Hyperparameters Matter
blogs.description: Many LoRA setups fall short of full‑model finetuning. This post distills the paper’s findings on how to place adapters across all transformer layers, why the number of adapters matters most, and which knobs (like rank r) matter less—so you can reliably hit 16‑bit parity.

blogs.title: Guanaco vs. ChatGPT: What the Scores Really Say
blogs.description: Guanaco reaches up to 99.3% of ChatGPT on the Vicuna benchmark—trained in ~24 hours on a single GPU. We’ll unpack how the authors evaluated with both GPT‑4 and humans, why they adopted Elo ratings, and what order effects and disagreements reveal about today’s chatbot benchmarks.

blogs.title: Quality Beats Quantity: Data Lessons from Finetuning 1,000+ Models
blogs.description: The study shows small, high‑quality instruction data (like OASST1) can outperform far larger corpora (like subsets of FLAN v2). We’ll explore why dataset suitability matters, why MMLU and chatbot scores can diverge, and how to pick data that matches your end goal.

blogs.title: Your First QLoRA Finetune: A Practical Roadmap
blogs.description: A hands‑on, jargon‑light guide to reproducing the paper’s approach with open‑source tools. We’ll cover choosing a base model, enabling 4‑bit quantization, placing LoRA adapters, selecting stable hyperparameters, and running lightweight evaluations—plus common pitfalls and fixes.

blogs.title: The Edge Is Calling: What QLoRA Means for On‑Device and Privacy‑First AI
blogs.description: With 4‑bit weights and adapter tuning, powerful models become practical on modest hardware. We’ll look at Guanaco’s small‑footprint deployments, what it implies for custom and private finetunes (even on phones), and how teams can cut costs while keeping data in‑house.
